data.one_liner: Unofficial Dart library to generate Agora.io WebRTC access tokens.
data.what_it_does: Generates Agora WebRTC tokens using app credentials, channel, uid, role and expiration. Implements the token algorithm based on Agora's Node.js reference implementation. Pure Dart with no native dependencies.
use_when: You need to create Agora access tokens on a Dart server or backend
You want a lightweight, platform‑agnostic way to generate tokens without native code
avoid_when: You require official, officially supported token generation
You need token validation or other Agora SDK features
strengths: Pure Dart, works on all Flutter platforms
weaknesses: Unofficial implementation may lag behind official spec
Only generates tokens, no validation or other Agora features
data.minimal_example:
final token = RtcTokenBuilder.build(
  appId: appId,
  appCertificate: appCertificate,
  channelName: channelName,
  uid: uid,
  role: role,
  expireTimestamp: expireTimestamp,
);
